thread:
Taylor: Quick pilot idea : drive-by appreciation — small table pop-ups where people can grab a pre-packed mini-spot kit and leave a short note. Want to trial in three offices next month. Need volunteers, a packing flow, and a tiny data capture plan. Thoughts?
Sofia: Love it. Which offices and counts?
Taylor: SF: 120/day (2 days), NY: 140 (1 day), Seattle: 80 (1 day). Remote mailout batch of 250. Total ~810 incl buffer.
Gabe: I'll run NY. Suggest we do manager setup + volunteer shifts after. Keep the pop-up low-friction.
Ivy: Kit contents? can we make a non-food option for dietary needs?
Taylor: Kit = printed thank-you card, enamel pin, compostable sticker, QR postcard to a 1-question pulse. For on-site, also have an allergy-friendly snack option label.
Carmen: Vendor rec: GreenBox handled compostable packaging before. Procurement can get a quote for 250 remote packs + local packs.
ops_bot: Note: For UK/EU shipments check VAT thresholds. See shipping-guidelines: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/shipping-guidelines
Sofia: Inventory owner? We need SKU, qty ordered, qty received, packer initials, ship date, tax-flag column if item unit > 150.
Gabe: I'll own inventory and add a "remote-ready" checkbox and a "donor note" field for handwritten message preference.
Ivy: Volunteer slots? I recommend 3 windows: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-14:00, 15:00-17:00. Manager-only setup first 30min.
Taylor: Agreed. Also need a 10-minute volunteer micro-training doc (kiosk etiquette, tax red flags, accessibility). Carmen can draft?
Carmen: Yes. I'll put a one-pager in the drive and a 7-min recorded walkthrough.
Sofia: Data capture: single-question pulse "Did this brighten your day? (yes/no)" with optional one-line comment. Use paramized link tiny.redwood/driveby?o=NY to track by office. Capture #kits handed out vs #responses.
Gabe: Add a QR code on postcard and a short URL printed. We'll compute response rate.
Taylor: For remote mailouts, standard import CSV required. Use this export-ready row:
```
EXPORT_ROW_TEMPLATE:
FullName | Street | City | Region | Postal | Country | Phone | OrderID
```
Sofia: Good. Also add a checkbox for "opt-in to a public shoutout" so we can feature recipients in All Hands if they consent.
ops_bot: Reminder: items that are cash-equivalent must be routed via payroll. Auto-flagging rule: unit_value > 150. See payroll/gift-tax doc.
Gabe: I'll add an auto-flag column and a filter view for tax review.
Carmen: Accessibility: reserve a lower-height table, seat, and have printed large-font cards. Add a quiet micro-space sign-up on the form.
Ivy: Logistics Q: do we do desk-drops for a small list of high-impact recipients? could be a manager request flow.
Taylor: Yes — add an "desk-drop request" checkbox on the inventory sheet and require manager approval column. We'll only allow desk-drops for high-impact recognitions to limit complexity.
Sofia: Comms: two-line blurb + office banner, plus a volunteer sign-up form. I'll draft blurb and share by EOD Friday.
Gabe: Inventory draft link: https://docs.redwood/driveby/inventory-2026 (edit for Gabe, Taylor, Sofia).
Carmen: Procurement pinged for quotes. ETA Tue. I'll include eco-packaging option.
Taylor: Next steps: Sofia finalizes signup and blurb by Friday, Gabe completes inventory template by Thu, Carmen gets vendor quotes by Tue. Quick check in Wednesday standup. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
